replan_note: Prior experiments confirmed cartservice pod_kill and refuted productcatalogservice pod_kill. Remaining critical services are currencyservice, emailservice, paymentservice, shippingservice, checkoutservice. We prioritize currencyservice (single point on checkout path) first, then emailservice (flaky dependency). Subsequent experiments will target paymentservice and shippingservice with network_partition, and finally checkoutservice with pod_kill to validate single entrypoint failure. Each plan uses distinct fault types to distinguish failure modes and measure customer impact via error_rate, p95_ms, and integrity_violations where applicable.
